note: The hooks file's event-name CASING selects the payload format: a camelCase name delivers camelCase fields, and the PascalCase alias delivers the VS Code compatible format with snake_case fields (hook_event_name, session_id, an ISO timestamp). Four events have no PascalCase alias.
